Sword & Shield series · FST

Fusion Strike

Released November 12, 2021 · 284 cards

Expanded

Fusion Strike is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on November 12, 2021. Its main set has 264 cards, plus 20 secret rares numbered beyond the set (284 in total). It includes 245 Pokémon, 36 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

80 illustrators worked on Fusion Strike. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (15), Yuu Nishida (10), Hideki Ishikawa (8), Misa Tsutsui (8), Akira Komayama (7), Kouki Saitou (7), Oswaldo KATO (7), Ryuta Fuse (7).
